description: Finds teams by name: a full name, a short name such as "suns", or a place such as "new york". Use it to get a team's id, or to check which teams a name means before creating a calendar from it, since "giants" is two teams. It finds racing drivers too, by their name ("hamilton") or their team's ("cadillac" finds its race drivers): pass a driver's slug in create_composed_calendar's drivers to follow that driver, which is how a fan of a driver follows them.
name: find_teams

league.description: The series' code, such as F1.

slug.description: The driver's slug, which create_composed_calendar's drivers and get_series_driver take.

teamId.description: The team they last drove for.

id.description: The team's id, which get_team_schedule and create_composed_calendar take.

league.description: The league's code, which list_teams and list_seasons take.

shortName.description: The name it usually goes by, such as Suns.

title: Find teams
